gates.exactQuestion: Trace current v1.25 ConditionalSpawnData.RemoveWhenDone from condition satisfaction through spawned-object removal, SpawnState cleanup/history handling, and save/reload persistence. Determine whether the field proves terminal object disposal, reference cleanup, both, or neither.
requiredOutput: managed/native method identities and call relationships
gates.runtimeEscalationRule: Escalate to 01E only if current v1.25 static code cannot settle event ordering or persistence semantics; freeze one minimal before/after/save/reload protocol.

conclusions.counterexampleExplanation: The event is DoOnce=false and its Mission condition is MissionStepStatus(step 9, Completed), which remains compatible with whole-Mission completion. Mission completion therefore does not force the event Conditions false and does not trigger UndoSpawn.

observedEvidence.privateEvidencePolicy: Full per-save indexes and exact raw address remain in private-derived 01A evidence / canonical handoff, not public repo.

ordering: Initialize reconstructs the current ConditionalEvent definition list and calls Evaluate(ConditionListener=-1) before registering ongoing event listeners.

Evaluate treats ActiveEvents map membership as the current active flag, reevaluates Conditions unless the event is already active with DoOnce=true, and acts only when evaluated truth differs from ActiveEvents membership.
On true->false transition Evaluate calls UndoAction(event,state) before ActiveEvents.Remove(event.ID).
Spawn action dispatch in UndoAction tail-calls UndoSpawn.

UndoSpawn checks ConditionalSpawnData.RemoveWhenDone. If false, it performs no GridObject removal. If true, it enumerates SpawnActionState.SpawnedObjects and constructs Meta.RemoveFromGrid request/response actions with the saved GridID/GridObjectID and Automatic=true.
UndoSpawn does not remove or clear individual SpawnedObjects addresses in place.
After UndoAction returns, Evaluate removes the entire ActiveEvents entry. Therefore successful event deactivation drops the persisted SpawnState structurally through ActiveEvents removal.

removeFromGridFailureBoundary.behavior: RemoveFromGrid validation can return InvalidGrid or InvalidGridObjectId when the saved address no longer materializes. UndoSpawn does not use the returned Apply result to retain/clear SpawnedObjects; ActiveEvents removal is ordered after UndoAction returns.
removeFromGridFailureBoundary.implication: Object-removal success and ActiveEvents/SpawnState cleanup are separate outcomes.

reloadPersistence.implication: A serialized active record is reevaluated on Initialize. It is removed only if the current event condition evaluates false (except already-active DoOnce events skip reevaluation). It is not auto-cleared merely because an associated Mission is completed.

retainedRecordClassification.implication: A retained ActiveEvents/SpawnState entry is not a historical archive marker, but a retained SpawnedObjects address can be stale/unmaterialized.

terminality.statement: RemoveWhenDone is an undo/removal policy consulted only when a Spawn ConditionalEvent transitions active->inactive. It does not prove Mission terminality, event deactivation, GridObject removal success, SpawnState cleanup by Mission completion, or absence of downstream consumers.

gates.exactQuestion: Within a bounded current-v1.25 progression-risk object family, audit native/script consumers/listeners that are not represented by the serialized 01D Mission/Condition/ConditionalEvent/Dialogue/Story/Ftue/canonical-definition graph.
requiredOutput: explicit UNKNOWN classes where negative proof is unavailable
gates.prohibition: Do not claim whole-game absence of dynamic/native consumers from a bounded search.
gates.conclusion: Target 2 is closed for the exact eight current-v1.25 Story Menhir Furniture definitions within the declared Game DB + current Switch IL2CPP metadata/string/call-relationship universe. The audit found consumers outside 01D, including a versioned Nurturing profile migration and ProfileWorld Keyhole state; explicit reflection/data-driven unknown classes remain fail-closed. No whole-game absence claim is made.

gates.exactQuestion: For each candidate object family that could become terminal-editable, prove that save progression phase agrees with GridObject.State, visual/variation state, SubGrid descendants, and linked persistent parameters for each requested operation.
gates.rule: Quest completion or absence of a current serialized consumer is never sufficient by itself.
gates.conclusion: Target 3 is operation-specifically closed for the exact Story Menhir family. Five members have no typed interaction state, three use GridState.Keyhole GUID linkage to ProfileWorld.Keyholes current persistent state, all eight have no SubGrid, and native Remove is forbidden for all eight. MOVE/ROTATE state preservation does not become positive mutation permission.

destinationProgressionVetoProjection.wepBoundary: WEP consumes Core operationVetoes/reasonCodes only; WEP must not reinterpret raw Mission state, Item flags, or save references.
